mission: Prove that DreamCo's declared internal systems resolve to real repository files, scripts, workflows, configs, generated artifacts or explicit external adapters, and expose orphan/dangling connections as engineering gaps.
release_blockers: required Run Everything tool path missing
quality_checks: external connection truth explicitly separated from internal file connection
truth_rule: Internal repository connectivity means references resolve and required builders/consumers agree. It does not prove an external API or platform is live-connected; external connections require their own runtime evidence.
